name: 9Router Self-Hosted AI Router and Gateway
description: OpenAI-compatible gateway for your own AI provider keys, with fallback.

upstream.9router: decolua/9router v0.5.116 (tag 2026-11-08, commit 1339107e), Docker Hub image decolua/9router:0.5.116@sha256:12086f97857f784ab7762e95595f70d71279a7a60c800af0f100183e8da7ea36 (Node.js 22.23.4, Alpine)

INITIAL_PASSWORD.description: Dashboard login password, generated at deploy (12-128 chars). Used until you set a password in the dashboard.

NINEROUTER_API_KEY.description: API key for /v1, generated at deploy and added to 9Router at boot. Empty removes it. 32-200 chars of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ ~ -

PORT.description: Port 9Router listens on (dual-stack); healthcheck and public domain target.

JWT_SECRET.description: Signs dashboard session cookies. Changing it signs everyone out.

API_KEY_SECRET.description: Secret 9Router uses for the checksum part of keys created in the dashboard.

MACHINE_ID_SALT.description: Salt for 9Router's instance id. Keep it stable after the first deploy.

BASE_URL.description: Public URL of this instance (used for OIDC/SAML sign-in callbacks).

NINEROUTER_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL for clients outside Railway. Reference only; not read by 9Router.

NINEROUTER_PRIVATE_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for services in this project over the private network (no egress). Reference only.
